When she fought the hero she ended up getting transported to Earth and at that moment when Seraphel realized she was on Earth she ended up celebrating because her plan worked. Seraphel was the one who spread the rumor that she was going to destroy the world of Atlas if she was not defeated.  But in reality, Seraphel just wanted to go to Earth for her 1000-year vacation.
